tornado.name: Sculpted storm
tornado.description: A readable dark spiral, a softer asymmetric crown, and a broad low dust skirt. Thick storm volume with lighter torn edges.
tornado.route: Keep a compact funnel mesh, add spiral surface detail and a fixed set of soft edge wisps. No new physics bodies.

tornado.name: Candy cyclone
tornado.description: Pearlescent wind ribbons with glimpses of red, green and purple debris. More open negative space and a visibly twisting silhouette.
tornado.route: Use a few animated ribbon meshes and instanced debris. Transparency would need an overdraw check on Quest.

tornado.name: Towering supercell
tornado.description: A broad low cloud canopy feeds a powerful curved funnel. Dense ground contact and a darker core create a much stronger sense of scale.
tornado.route: Use layered cloud geometry and baked shading rather than a volumetric fluid simulation.

tsunami.name: Turquoise breaker
tsunami.description: Deep blue weight at the foot, luminous turquoise toward the crest, and irregular white foam tearing down the steep face.
tsunami.route: Retain the existing GPU wave surface and collision profile; add crest and streak masks, with tightly capped spray.

tsunami.name: Liquid candy glass
tsunami.description: Clear saturated aqua, broad juicy highlights, subtle bubbles and a thin lace-like white lip. The water feels dense and glossy.
tsunami.route: Use depth color and reflection cues first; true screen refraction and transparency would need separate GPU profiling.

tsunami.name: Whitewater wall
tsunami.description: A jagged, frothy leading crest, layered sheets of foam, and chunky spray give the wave visible destructive weight.
tsunami.route: Keep the same wave envelope; animate foam in the shader and reuse a bounded spray pool.
